halves.name: Open-Book Golden Retriever
halves.desc: You love out loud and in full view: warm, gentle, all in, and never by anyone else's rulebook.

axes.line: You recharge with your people. Close means shared.
You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: Chill Personified
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, but you never blow the budget doing it.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You give so fast that you're running on empty before anyone notices.
You're not unambitious. Nothing has been worth the grind yet.
hearts: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Yes first, bank app later
tags.heart: Breaking my own rules for my people? No regrets.
tags.sting: One ask from a friend and your budget rules vanish. They only ever apply to you.

youToldGenii.said: Went, paid, and ate instant noodles for a week.
Said 'ten minutes.' Left three hours later.
Call, put them on speaker, "mhm" until one of us sleeps.

tags.name: Compliment sandwich chef
tags.heart: I say it softly so you can actually hear it.
tags.sting: You wrap the truth in so much sugar that some people only taste the sugar.

youToldGenii.said: Took them for bubble tea first. Brought it up on the walk back.
Rave about the verse. Mumble "maybe a louder chorus?" Change the subject.
Mirror: "Do you love it? Then I love it."

tags.name: Head over heels, eyes open
tags.heart: I love all the way, and I know where the door is.
tags.sting: You say you're independent. You still want to be in every part of their day.

youToldGenii.said: Left early together. The walk home was the best part.
The secrets. That closeness was supposed to be ours.
We can do nothing together for hours and it's perfect.

tags.name: Relationship mechanic
tags.heart: I don't quit on people I chose.
tags.sting: You'll fix what's broken, including things that aren't yours to fix.

youToldGenii.said: Sat them down and made an actual deal.
Make a shared doc with deadlines a day early. Secretly.

tags.name: Close Friends list: 4
tags.heart: The ones I choose always know it.
tags.sting: You're not cold. New people just wait about a year for the warm version.

youToldGenii.said: Courier. Screenshots the good stuff straight to my two favorites.
Just us two, their couch, their comfort show.

calls.line: You've paid for a friend's ticket and 'forgot' to ask for it back.
You've said 'honestly, it's so close!' about something that was not close.
You've sent your person a photo of your lunch that needed no caption.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘The neighbor's. My plant has a backstory now.’ Last time, you did: ‘Went deep on my own thing. Game, sketch, gym, guitar.’
